anchor.name: Anchor
anchor.note: The v6 ink bar is sized and centred on the active link through custom properties the v4 stylesheet ignores, so the default theme keeps its 8 px ball.

badge.name: Badge
badge.note: ng-zorro keeps the v4 status colour class alongside the new v6 colour class so the default stylesheet is unchanged.

breadcrumb.name: Breadcrumb
breadcrumb.note: The antd basic demo has one more crumb than ng-zorro’s. Under v6 the separator is drawn as an inline block so template whitespace no longer widens the gap.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.note: antd pads day numbers to two digits through its date format; ng-zorro prints them unpadded. Demo dates differ.

carousel.name: Carousel
carousel.note: The carousel autoplays, so the harness could not take a stable antd-side screenshot; ng-zorro shots are shown alone.

collapse.name: Collapse
collapse.note: The ng-zorro basic demo disables its third panel while the antd demo does not. Demo content, not styling.

date-picker.name: Date Picker
date-picker.note: The antd demo lays its pickers out in a row; ng-zorro’s demo stacks them. Each picker’s own box matches. Demo layout, not component styling.

empty.name: Empty
empty.note: ng-zorro’s default illustration renders with more contrast than antd 6’s.

float-button.name: Float Button
float-button.note: The antd float-button demos are viewport-fixed, so their captures show an empty demo box; the ng-zorro side is the meaningful one.

form.name: Form
form.note: The antd advanced-search demo marks fields required and uses a different column count. Demo content, not component styling.

image.name: Image
image.note: ng-zorro keeps the close action inside the bottom toolbar (antd 6 draws a separate top-right close button). Listed in docs/v6-api-gaps.md.

menu.name: Menu
menu.note: Submenu popups open in a CDK overlay; under a [nzTheme] scope the pane carries the scope class so popups inherit the theme.

message.name: Message
message.note: Message and Notification are viewport-fixed overlays; the antd pane cannot capture them, so only ng-zorro opened states are shown.

modal.name: Modal
modal.note: Opened modals are captured on the ng-zorro side only; the antd pane cannot capture a viewport-fixed overlay.

notification.name: Notification
notification.note: Message and Notification are viewport-fixed overlays; the antd pane cannot capture them, so only ng-zorro opened states are shown.

select.name: Select
select.note: antd 6 draws the box on the select root; ng-zorro keeps its nested selector box and mirrors the rules onto it, so the DOMs differ while the renders match.

statistic.name: Statistic
statistic.note: A statistic without a title keeps its v4 title box for the default stylesheet; under v6 a patch rule hides the empty box so the height matches antd 6.

steps.name: Steps
steps.note: ng-zorro adds antd 6’s rail, section and wrapper classes next to its v4 ones; title, description and progress-ring rules are mirrored onto the existing elements.

tabs.name: Tabs
tabs.note: antd 6 renamed the pane chain (body-holder / body / content); ng-zorro emits the new names next to its v4 ones.

tag.name: Tag
tag.note: ng-zorro renders antd 6’s default filled variant for a plain tag; the bordered look is available through the variant input.

timeline.name: Timeline
timeline.note: Ant Design 6 draws Timeline through Steps in dot mode. The build copies the Steps CSS with its class prefix rewritten to ant-timeline.
